name: SJSU18-O2
description: Planar secular Sun-Jupiter-Saturn-Uranus Hamiltonian, polynomial of degree 18 in the secular Poincare variables, reconstructed from the recipe of Sansottera-Locatelli-Giorgilli (2013) section 3 strictly at order two in the masses (plus the resonant mu^4 terms of their eq. (12)). It is a reconstruction, not the authors' data file; see README and docs/explorations/sjsu-model-recovery.md for every known difference.

conventions.units: AU, year, G = 1, m0 = 4 pi^2 (SLG13 Table 1)
conventions.masses: m_j = m0 / M_j with M_j = 1047.355, 3498.5, 22902.98 read as exact decimals
conventions.canonical_variables: Poincare (canonical heliocentric), SLG13 eq. (2): Lambda_j = beta_j sqrt(mu_j a_j), beta_j = m0 m_j/(m0+m_j), mu_j = G (m0+m_j); xi_j = sqrt(2 Gamma_j) cos varpi_j, eta_j = -sqrt(2 Gamma_j) sin varpi_j, Gamma_j = Lambda_j (1 - sqrt(1 - e_j^2))
conventions.symplectic_structure: coordinates (lambda_j, eta_j), momenta (Lambda_j, xi_j): {eta_j, xi_j} = 1, so d eta/dt = dH/dxi, d xi/dt = -dH/deta
conventions.complex_variables: z_j = (xi_j - i eta_j)/sqrt(2) = sqrt(Gamma_j) e^{i varpi_j}; {z_j, conj z_j} = -i; dz/dt = -i dH/d(conj z)
conventions.secular_variables: the (xi, eta) after the near-identity transformations chi_1, chi_2 (and chi_res) at L = 0, as in SLG13 eq. (9)/(12); not the osculating Poincare variables

truncations.mass_order: strict two (all terms of the Lie series of order <= 2)

parameters.astar_source: applications/sjsu/validation/astar.json: time average over 0 <= t <= 1e6 yr of the Poincare semi-major axes a_j (from r_j and r~_j/beta_j with mu_j = G(m0+m_j)) along the planar SJSU N-body flow from SLG13 Table 1 read as Poincare elements; WH democratic-heliocentric map, Yoshida 4th order, dt = 0.5 yr, float64 (scripts/nbody.py)

precision.arithmetic: mpmath, 40 significant digits (binary precision 136 bits) throughout; inputs: exact rational Kepler series, Laplace coefficients summed in mpmath at 40 digits, masses and a* as exact decimals
precision.note: reversibility (c_PQ = c_QP) and reality are enforced exactly after checking that the computed asymmetry and imaginary parts are at round-off level (symmetrization); see validation/precision.json for the float64 / long double / mpmath comparison

provenance.build_record: sjsu18-o2.SOURCE.txt (generator commit, command, environment, CPU time, intermediate hash)
sources: SLG13: M. Sansottera, U. Locatelli, A. Giorgilli, Math. Comput. Simul. 88 (2013) 1-14, doi:10.1016/j.matcom.2010.11.018, arXiv:1010.2609v1, sections 2-3, Table 1, Appendix A
GLS17: A. Giorgilli, U. Locatelli, M. Sansottera, Regul. Chaotic Dyn. 22 (2017) 54-77, arXiv:1702.04894v1, section 2

complex_form.variables: z_j = (xi_j - i eta_j)/sqrt(2) = sqrt(Gamma_j) e^{i varpi_j}; {z_j, conj z_j} = -i; dz/dt = -i dH/d(conj z)
